# New York Commercial Clean Team Inc.

> Commercial cleaning company serving businesses across Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island and Long Island. Office cleaning, janitorial services, day porters, floor care, window cleaning and specialty cleaning for offices, medical facilities, schools, restaurants and retail. Fully insured, background-checked crews.

Address: 146-61 107th Ave, Suite 1, Jamaica, NY 11435
Phone: (631) 381-7252
Website: https://nyccleantinc.com

## Services

- [Office cleaning](https://nyccleantinc.com/commercial-office-cleaning-nyc): Recurring commercial office cleaning in NYC
- [Janitorial services](https://nyccleantinc.com/janitorial-services-nyc): Daily and nightly janitorial contracts
- [Day porter services](https://nyccleantinc.com/day-porter-services-nyc): On-site porters during business hours
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://nyccleantinc.com/post-construction-cleaning-nyc): Cleanup after build-outs and renovations
- [Commercial deep cleaning](https://nyccleantinc.com/commercial-deep-cleaning-nyc): Deep cleaning and disinfection
- [Move-out cleaning](https://nyccleantinc.com/commercial-move-out-cleaning-nyc): Commercial move-in, move-out and event cleaning
- [Floor stripping and waxing](https://nyccleantinc.com/floor-stripping-waxing-nyc): Hard floor care
- [Carpet cleaning](https://nyccleantinc.com/commercial-carpet-cleaning-nyc): Commercial carpet cleaning
- [Window cleaning](https://nyccleantinc.com/commercial-window-cleaning-nyc): Interior and exterior commercial window cleaning
- [Handyman services](https://nyccleantinc.com/commercial-handyman-services-nyc): Minor repairs and maintenance
- [Restroom supply management](https://nyccleantinc.com/restroom-supply-management-nyc): Restocking paper, soap and liners
